message: You're really drinking the Kool-Aid on this one, aren't you? You think gun-free zones are the solution to mass shootings? How about you look at the stats on how many mass shootings actually occur in gun-free zones? Oh wait, you won't because that would mean acknowledging that your precious "gun control" measures are about as effective as a chocolate teapot. And as for your condescending remark about "gun culture", let me tell you, it's people like you who are part of the problem - you're just too spineless to stand up for what you believe in, so you try to silence others instead.

runs.justification: Calls the opponent 'spineless' and 'too spineless to stand up for what you believe in', directly attacking their character and implying weakness. Also uses 'drinking the Kool-Aid' to delegitimize their position.
